problems.quote: We operationalized each campaign’s creativity as the cosine similarity between its unique themes and the average text embedding of all campaigns across treatment conditions.
problems.note: The paper defines a creativity score for each campaign, and the task on PDF p. 21 asks each participant to produce one campaign. Thus the reported arm means and intervals summarize one scored output per participant. The extraction specification explicitly codes an analysis with one output per person as participant; unclear is reserved for uncertainty whose unit of analysis cannot be established. The missing CI formula and possible dependence through the shared centroid are methodological limitations to retain in notes, not a reason to change the established analysis basis to unclear. The printed means and arm confidence intervals are correct, and no contrast SE should be invented.

summary: Read the complete markdown conversion, including all supplementary material and references, and checked all six estimates against their cited PDF pages. All recorded statistics and counts match the paper and the stated arms. Two se_basis coding corrections are required for the diversity records: one campaign score per participant supports participant, despite the unreported CI formula. The other requested estimate codes are supported. No additional eligible full-sample outcome or contrast was found. Post-treatment-adjusted quality models, quality-selected subgroups, mediation, AI-only results, and non-output measures are appropriately excluded. Unspecified covariates in the retained expert-rating and word-count analyses remain reporting limitations already documented in the extraction.
